create_SE_layer_2D: create a SqueezeAndExcitationLayer2D instance with a given input channel dimension and reduction ratio
create_SE_layer_custom_reduced: create a SqueezeAndExcitationLayer2D instance with a custom reduced_planes value instead of reduction ratio
run_SE_forward: run forward pass through a SqueezeAndExcitationLayer2D on a 2D tensor to apply channel-wise scaling
create_audio_2d_se_block: create a 2D residual block with optional squeeze excitation using create_audio_2d_squeeze_excitation_block
review_SE_layer: review the SqueezeAndExcitationLayer2D class to understand its adaptive average pooling and excitation mechanism
